target_customer: Bridge inspectors, expanding to home inspectors
problem: Inspectors fill paper forms and photograph defects by hand; OSIMple gives a tablet app that captures data and generates the completed inspection form as a PDF, claiming almost half the inspection time saved.
business_model: B2B software for inspectors, subscription implied but pricing not found
product_category: Inspection data capture and report generation software

founders.name: Amanda Chan
founders.background_notes: YC bio says she works on Bridge Inspections. A CB Insights snippet lists past roles at MetricWire and AtkinsRealis but the page was blocked, so they are not recorded.

founders.name: Mike Miller
founders.background_notes: Listed as Founder/CTO on the YC page, which says he previously co-founded OSIMple.

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile form capture app with photo organization and PDF generation is standard app engineering, with offline use as the main difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: Form digitization had no stated lock-in, data advantage or contracts, so rivals could copy it quickly.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found; the launch post describes old clunky inspection applications.

market_need_then: The launch post says inspectors used pen, paper and cameras or clunky apps needing constant internet, and the product had been used on over 400 bridges by February 2018.

branding.domain_note: Used osimple.co, a .co domain; the site returned HTTP 503 on fetch.

brand_strength.rationale: Only directory listings and a Launch HN post mention it; no press about the brand and the name was easily confused with unrelated firms in searches.

pivots.why: Launch HN post says they began with bridge inspectors and were expanding to home inspection

outcome_analysis: OSIMple built an inspection data capture app used on over 400 bridges, joined YC in Winter 2018 and raised about 120 thousand dollars per a database. Directories list it as inactive, but no shutdown, acquisition or post-mortem was found, so the cause of inactivity is not public. The founders moved on to other work by the time of the YC page, with the CTO described as a former co-founder.
notes: Site osimple.co returned HTTP 503; treated as dead. The seed round rests on CB Insights alone and its January 1 2018 date looks like a placeholder, so the date is year only. The Launch HN post is read from an aggregator repost dated February 28, 2018. No competitors are named in the post; a search for Spectora returned only recent pages, so no dated competitor was recorded. Founders' education and prior employers not found. Founded year not found.
